import json
base = '/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/results/tracvla_object/trained'
for fname in ['action_r2_probing','l1_attention_profile','cross_instruction_classification','counterfactual_combined']:
    path = f'{base}/{fname}.json'
    try:
        d = json.load(open(path))
        print(f'\n--- {fname} ---')
        if fname == 'action_r2_probing':
            for pos in d:
                vals = d[pos]
                keys = sorted(vals.keys(), key=lambda x: int(x.split('_')[-1]) if '_' in x else int(x[1:]))
                peak_k = max(vals, key=vals.get)
                last_k = keys[-1]
                for lk in keys:
                    ln = int(lk.split('_')[-1]) if '_' in lk else int(lk[1:])
                    if ln in [0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28,31]:
                        print(f'  {pos} {lk}: {vals[lk]:.4f}')
                print(f'  {pos} PEAK: {vals[peak_k]:.4f} @ {peak_k}')
                print(f'  {pos} LAST: {vals[last_k]:.4f}')
        elif fname == 'l1_attention_profile':
            ratios = d.get('per_head_instruction_ratio', d)
            instr = sum(1 for v in ratios.values() if float(v) > 0.5)
            print(f'  Instr-dominant: {instr}/{len(ratios)}')
            top = sorted(ratios.items(), key=lambda x: float(x[1]), reverse=True)[:5]
            bot = sorted(ratios.items(), key=lambda x: float(x[1]))[:3]
            print(f'  Top: {[(k,round(float(v),3)) for k,v in top]}')
            print(f'  Bottom: {[(k,round(float(v),3)) for k,v in bot]}')
        elif fname == 'cross_instruction_classification':
            vals = list(d.values())
            keys = list(d.keys())
            print(f'  First ({keys[0]}): {vals[0]:.4f}')
            print(f'  Last ({keys[-1]}): {vals[-1]:.4f}')
            print(f'  Min: {min(vals):.4f}, Max: {max(vals):.4f}')
        elif fname == 'counterfactual_combined':
            for k,v in d.items():
                if isinstance(v, dict):
                    print(f'  {k}: cos_dist={v.get(\"cos_dist_mean\",v.get(\"cos_dist\",\"?\"))}, d={v.get(\"cohens_d\",\"?\")}, cross_task_d={v.get(\"cross_task_mean_d\",\"?\")}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'--- {fname} ERROR: {e} ---')
"
